resources.string: Pasiva

Cuando este Operativo vaya a realizar una acción de misión (excluyendo **Retrieve**, Tacop 2025), si requiere que el Operativo controle ese Objetivo, puedes determinar el control usando uno de tus **OBELISK NODE** (vease más en las reglas de facción). Cuando este Operativo vaya a realizar la acción **Operate Hatch**, puedes abrir o cerrar esa puerta si está a 1\" de tu **OBELISK NODE** en su lugar.\n \nNotese que aun tiene cumplir las condiciones de la accion de **Operate Hatch**
1AP

Selecciona un punto en una pieza de terreno; ese punto debe ser visible y a 8\" de ese Operativo. Lanza por separado 2D6 por cada Operativo a 2\" de ese punto. Si el resultado es mayor al número de heridas restantes de ese Operativo, inflige daño equivalente a la diferencia.\n\n
Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras tenga una orden de Conceal o mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo.
1AP

**SUPPORT**. Selecciona un aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** visible y a 6\" de este Operativo. Alternativamente puedes seleccionar a un **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** que sea visible y que esté dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** (**SUPPORT** no aplica para esta selección). Ese Operativo seleccionado puede inmediatamente hacer una accion de 1AP gratis; pero no puede moverse o ser removido a más de 2\" durante esa acción.
Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo o en un Counteract.
1AP

**SUPPORT**. Selecciona un aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** visible y a 6" de este Operativo. Alternativamente puedes seleccionar a un **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** que sea visible y que esté dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** (**SUPPORT** no aplica para esta selección).
 
• La próxima vez que el Operativo seleccionado haga una acción en la que se mueva, no lo muevas normalmente. Remuévelo del campo de batalla y vuelvelo a poner en el campo una distancia equivalente a su estadística de movimiento (o a 3" si uso un dash) horizontalmente de su lugar original (en killzones con espacios cerrados como ITD o Tombworld , puedes medir esto a través de paredes, el Operativo puede ponerse al otro lado de una pared).
 
Notese que no gana distancia adicional cuando hace la accion de **Cargar**. Debe ser puesto en un lugar donde pueda sostenerse y a menos que se trate de una accion de **Cargar**, No puede ser puesto dentro del rango de control de un Operativo enemigo.


Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo.
1AP

Selecciona otro aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** visible y a 3\" de este Operativo. Alternativamente puedes seleccionar otro aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** que esté dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**. Hasta el final de su siguiente activación, añade 1 a su estadística de APL.\n\n
Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo.
1AP

Selecciona un enemigo visible y a 3\" de este Operativo. Alternativamente, si este Operativo está dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, puedes seleccionar a un Operativo enemigo que este dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**. Hasta el final de la siguiente activación de ese Operativo, sustrae 1 a su estadística de APL.\n\n
Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo.
Pasiva

Una vez por turno, cuando otro aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** vaya a ser incapacitado, si ese Operativo es visible y a 6" de este Operativo, o si este y ese Operativo están dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, puedes usar esta regla, siempre y cuando ninguno de esos Operativos esté en rango de control de un Operativo enemigo.
 
Si lo haces, ese Operativo no es incapacitado, tiene 1 herida restante y no puede ser incapacitado durante el resto de la acción. Después de esa acción, ese aliado puede inmediatamente hacer un **Dash** gratis, pero debes terminar esa acción dentro del rango de control de este Operativo o dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**.
 
Sustrae 1 a la estadística de APL de ambos Operativos hasta el fin de sus próximas activaciones, si esta regla fue usada durante la activación de ese Operativo, esa activación termina.
 
No puedes usar esta regla si este Operativo es incapacitado, o si es un **Disparo** y este Operativo es seleccionado como objetivo primario o secundario.
1AP

Selecciona un aliado **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** visible y a 6\" de este Operativo. Alternativamente, si este Operativo está en tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** puedes seleccionar a un **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** que esté dentro de tu **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**. El operativo seleccionado recupera 3D3 heridas perdidas. No puede usar esta regla con un Operativo que haya usado la regla **Reanimate** este turno.\n\n
Este Operativo no puede realizar esta acción mientras esté en rango de control de un enemigo o más de una vez por turno.
Pasiva
Si este Operativo es incapacitado por un enemigo que esté a 2\" de este, antes de ser removido del campo, lanza un D3: al 2+, inflige 1 daño a ese Operativo enemigo.
Pasiva

Este Operativo es ignorado para la Kill op de tu oponente (cuando es incapacitado y cuando determinas tu número inicial de Operativos). También es ignorado para condiciones de victoria o puntuar Victory points si requiere que este Operativo \‘escape\’, \‘sobreviva\’ o sea incapacitado por Operativos enemigos.
Pasiva

As a **STRATEGIC GAMBIT** in each turning point after the first, if you have less than three non-incapacitated friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE WARRIOR** operatives, you can set up another one ready and with a Conceal order wholly within your drop zone (you can select its weapon options as normal).
Special Weapon Rule

After this operative uses this weapon, if you inflicted damage or retained any critical successes, if the target was not incapacitated, roll 2D6: if the result is higher than the targets remaining wounds, the target is incapacitated (taking precedence over rules that prevent incapacitation, e.g. Medic!, **FELLGOR RAVAGER** Frenzy) and your opponent cannot place a Reanimation marker (**HIEROTEK CIRCLE**) for that operative, if relevant.
Pasiva

Whenever your opponent is selecting a valid target, if this operative has a Conceal order, it cannot use Light terrain for cover. While this can allow this operative to be targeted (assuming it is visible), it does not remove its cover save (if any).
Pasiva
Whenever determining control of a marker, you can treat this operative’s APL stat as 3. If you do, this takes precedence over all other rules, meaning any changes to its APL stat are ignored for this

Obelisk nodes are concentrations of Necron technology, hubs of energy and data streams. Whether raised up from their sites of ancient burial, formed from restructured local matter or phased into place from a pocket dimension, these angular nodes can empower a Cryptek and their servants. Impelled into positions where they can connect in a matrix of power, they aid the Crypteks ambitions whilst hampering their foes.

As a **STRATEGIC GAMBIT** in the first turning point, place your three **OBELISK NODE** markers wholly within your territory. As a **STRATEGIC GAMBIT** in each turning point after the first, you can move each of your **OBELISK NODE** markers up to 3" horizontally.
 
 Your **OBELISK NODE** markers control other markers within 1" of them that no enemy operatives contest (treat your **OBELISK NODE** markers as friendly operatives for this purpose). If more than one player would use their **OBELISK NODE** markers to control the same marker, no **OBELISK NODE** markers control it.
 
 Whenever one of your **OBELISK NODE** markers is within 6" horizontally of another of your **OBELISK NODE** markers, those markers and the area between them create an **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** above and below (in other words, their height in the killzone is irrelevant). If all three of your **OBELISK NODE** markers fulfil this, it creates a larger combined **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**.
 
 Whenever a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative is within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**:
 
 • Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
 
 • Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).
With a flick of their digits, a skilled Geomancer can use this enhanced geomantic manipulator as a surrogate obelisk node to extend the matrix.

Once per battle, during a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operatives activation or counteraction, you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of that activation/counteraction, a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE GEOMANCER** operative is treated as your fourth **OBELISK NODE** marker.
Seeded into place and activated long ago, these obelisk nodes have absorbed huge stores of local data, ready to gift their controller with a superior edge when the time is right.
After revealing this equipment option, roll one D3. You can use the Animate Obelisk Nodes firefight ploy for 0CP a number of times during the battle equal to the result.
These small devices appear to release wisps of spectral vapour. In truth, they are clouds of tiny repair constructs that seal rents in living metal.
Whenever a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative is activated, it regains up to D3 lost wounds.
The bearers form flits between dimensions like a phantom, rendering it exceedingly difficult to land a telling blow upon them.

Once per turning point, when an operative is shooting a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE GEOMANCER **operative, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step, you can use this rule. If you do, worsen the x of the Piercing weapon rule by 1 (if any) until the end of that sequence. Note that Piercing 1 would therefore be ignored.

Quantum energies radiate from the matrix, triggered by warding protocols. The haze consumes solid shot in bursts of viridian light and refracts energy blasts, while its wavering veil confounds targeters.

Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative, if your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** is intervening, or that friendly operative is within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, you can re-roll any of your defence dice results of one result (e.g. results of 2).
Curving into arcane lenses that compress slivers of reality, the shimmering matrix magnifies the potency of the Necrons horrifying energistic technologies.

Whenever a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative is shooting, if your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** is intervening, or the target is within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, that friendly operatives weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule.
The universes fundamental forces have long been mastered by the Necrons. As their foes advance, thudding waves and twisting eddies of gravity amongst the obelisk nodes repel potential trespassers.

Once per action, the first time an enemy operative would move within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, the distance is treated as an additional 1\". Note this means if that enemy operative does not have sufficient move distance (e.g. it’s at the end of its move), that operative cannot move within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX.**
A lifeless chill creeps into the hearts of those who would dare to breach the Necrons realm – an enervating leeching of strength and vitality that leaves them easy prey.

Whenever an enemy operative is within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, or whenever it is fighting or retaliating against a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative that’s within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, subtract 1 from both Dmg stats of that enemy operatives melee weapons (to a minimum of 2) until the end of the activation/counteraction. Note this means if the enemy operative moves through your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, apply this change at the end of that move action until the end of the activation/counteraction.

With a flash, snipers bullets are swallowed in microdimensions; blades pass through suddenly phased matter; slivers of time are erased and rewritten, the strike never connecting after all. The matrix’s energies deny the Necrons verminous foes of the smallest victory over their betters.

Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts Normal Dmg on a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operative. If your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX** is intervening, or that friendly operative is within your **OBELISK NODE MATRIX**, ignore that inflicted damage. Note your opponent determines intervening (i.e. where on their operative’s base to draw the targeting lines from).
Heeding some hidden command, looming obelisk nodes surge into new positions of cosmic conjunction.

Use this firefight ploy when it is your turn to activate or counteract with a friendly operative. Move any number of your **OBELISK NODE** markers instead. They can move up to 6\" horizontally combined, and distances are always rounded up to the nearest inch (so if you move a marker 1.5\", it’s treated as moving it 2\"). For example, you could move one marker 6\", three markers 1\" each, or any combination that does not exceed 6\" in total. You can also move them 0\" (to effectively skip an activation). In any case, your opponent activates as normal afterwards.
Eldritch pulses of artificial thought thrum through the obelisk nodes as they adjust the flow of energies and data in response to rapidly changing situations.

Use this firefight ploy during a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE** operatives activation, before or after it performs an action. You can either change one of the strategy ploys you used during this turning point (only pay additional CP if that ploy costs more), or use a strategy ploy now (pay its CP cost as normal).
Canoptek constructs are programmed to shield their master at all costs.

Use this firefight ploy when a friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE GEOMANCER** operative is selected as the valid target of a **Shoot** action or to fight against during the **Fight** action. Select one other friendly **CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK** operative visible to and within 3\" of that first friendly operative to become the valid target or to be fought against (as appropriate) instead (even if it would not normally be valid for this). If it is the **Fight** action, treat that other operative as being within the fighting operatives control range for the duration of that action. If it is the **Shoot** action, that other operative is only in cover or obscured if the original target was.\n \n This ploy has no effect if it is the **Shoot** action and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent weapon rule.
